content:
**AGENT-PRIORITY-HANDOFF.md invariants expired: #435 shipped, main moved, issue count drifted**

What: Measured docs/inbox/AGENT-PRIORITY-HANDOFF.md's own §1 expiry invariants against live state on 2026-08-20.
Why: Requested milestone-board audit (M0-M10) + queue-derivation check + #682 completion measurement + issue-label counts.
Where: docs/inbox/AGENT-PRIORITY-HANDOFF.md, docs/inbox/MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md, docs/inbox/brain-v2-epic-plan.md, issue #313 (source of truth), issue #335/#336 (M10), origin/feature/issue-682.
Learned:
- #435 (npm publish) is CLOSED and @logikas/brain@1.1.0 is LIVE on the registry (published 2026-08-18, not the 404 the handoff still claims). This is the single biggest stale claim — the doc calls it "the only item that moved in zero of four cuts, human-only."
- main moved from 9e9cd36 (handoff's anchor) to 46fb991 — 23 first-parent commits ahead, including the #435 ship, #717 handoff refresh itself, #723/#710 D6 wiring fix, #727 publish credential rehearsal fix, #729 ADR-0006 Amendment 2.
- Open issue count drifted: 71 open (not 66). ADR malformed census still holds at zero (that invariant is durable).
- #631 now carries status:approved — handoff §7 still lists it among "6 tickets sin aprobar" needing a human signature. Stale.
- #723 and #710 are both CLOSED (merged via PR #733) — handoff describes #723 as "recién firmado" pending work; it already shipped.
- M5 (#312, role-as-port) confirmed still at zero implementation: brain/roles/ does not exist on origin/main.
- issue #313's body (updated 2026-08-16) is far more current than the two frozen docs (MASTER-PLAN-1.0.md, brain-v2-epic-plan.md, both explicitly self-declared 2026-07-24 snapshots) — #313 is the right place to re-derive the milestone table, not the inbox docs.
- On origin/feature/issue-682 (27 commits ahead of main, no PR ever opened, 0% on main): tasks.md Slice 1 (8/8) and Slice 2 (7/7) fully ticked, Slice 3 (0/6) untouched. REQ-682-5 (convergence.maxRounds as a separate key) has NO task in any slice — explicitly recorded as an orphaned requirement in tasks.md itself, not an oversight I found.
